name: Piscivorenantiornis
sum: Enantiornithine from the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning found with a pellet of fish bones.
holotype: IVPP V22582, with a spindle-shaped mass of fish bones probably of Lycoptera.
material: The holotype and a second specimen.
exceptional: A regurgitated pellet of fish bones.
biology: The fish bones are interpreted as a pellet, the first evidence of fish-eating in an enantiornithine.
author: Wang and Zhou 2017

sources.text: Wang, Min; Zhou, Zhonghe 2017. A morphological study of the first known piscivorous enantiornithine bird from the Early Cretaceous of China. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 37(2). doi:10.1080/02724634.2017.1278702
